# SPX Graphics Controller (`tuomoku-spx-gc`)

Elevate your live productions with SPX Graphics Controller! Seamlessly manage HTML graphics across platforms like OBS, vMix, and more. Ideal for stunning live streams and broadcasts with powerful customization.

[Source](https://github.com/TuomoKu/SPX-GC)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "tuomoku-spx-gc"
  name       = "mygc"

  parameters = {
    # Username       = "..."
    # S3TemplatesUrl = "..."
    # S3ProjectsUrl  = "..."
    # S3PluginsUrl   = "..."
    # S3MediaUrl     = "..."
    # S3JsonUrl      = "..."
    # S3EndpointUrl  = "..."
    # S3AccessKeyId  = "..."
    # S3Region       = "..."
  }

  sensitive_parameters = {
    Password = var.password
    S3SecretAccessKey = var.s3_secret_access_key
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `Username` | string | no | Username for SPX authentication. If provided along with password, users will be required to login to access the application. |
| `Password` | string | no | Password for SPX authentication. Works in conjunction with username to enable login protection for the application. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `S3TemplatesUrl` | string | no | S3 bucket URL or path for storing and retrieving HTML graphics templates used by SPX for live production graphics. |
| `S3ProjectsUrl` | string | no | S3 bucket URL or path for storing SPX projects and rundowns data that would normally be stored in the DATAROOT folder. |
| `S3PluginsUrl` | string | no | Configures the S3 bucket URL for storing SPX plugins and extensions. Plugins provide additional functionality like custom controls and user interface panels. |
| `S3MediaUrl` | string | no | Configures the S3 bucket URL for storing media assets like images, videos, and other files used by graphics templates. |
| `S3JsonUrl` | string | no | Specifies the S3 bucket URL for storing and retrieving JSON data files used for data-driven graphics and external data integration. |
| `S3EndpointUrl` | string | no | Custom S3-compatible endpoint URL for accessing object storage services other than AWS S3, such as MinIO, DigitalOcean Spaces, or other S3-compatible storage providers. |
| `S3AccessKeyId` | string | no | AWS access key ID for authenticating with S3 services to access templates, projects, and media assets stored in cloud storage. |
| `S3SecretAccessKey` | string | no | AWS secret access key for authenticating with S3 services, paired with the access key ID for secure cloud storage access. Sensitive, set it in `sensitive_parameters`. |
| `S3Region` | string | no | AWS region identifier specifying the geographical region where the S3 buckets are located for optimal performance and compliance. |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
